items.title: A new deep learning model maps global methane emissions from space.
items.content: Google and NASA JPL developed an AI model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space using EMIT.
items.contentSnippet: Google and NASA JPL developed an AI model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space using EMIT.

summaries.zh: 谷歌与NASA JPL合作开发了一种新的深度学习模型，利用EMIT卫星从太空绘制和量化全球甲烷排放。该模型通过分析卫星数据，实现了对全球甲烷排放的高精度监测和评估。
summaries.en: Google and NASA JPL have created a new deep learning model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space, utilizing the Earth Surface Mineral Dust Transport mission (EMIT). The model enhances the ability to detect and measure methane sources, contributing to improved environmental monitoring. The technology provides detailed, high-resolution data to support global efforts in tracking and reducing methane pollution.

items.summary: 谷歌与NASA JPL合作开发了一种新的深度学习模型，利用EMIT卫星从太空绘制和量化全球甲烷排放。该模型通过分析卫星数据，实现了对全球甲烷排放的高精度监测和评估。

items.title: Recreating a 70-year love story frame by frame
items.content: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."
items.contentSnippet: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."

summaries.zh: 影片《Love, Rendered》展示了电影制作人与谷歌DeepMind如何运用人工智能技术，通过AI重现一对恋人未记录的过往。该短片以逐帧重构的方式呈现了他们的70年爱情故事，融合了科技与情感。
summaries.en: The short film "Love, Rendered" showcases filmmakers and Google DeepMind using AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded 70-year love story. The project digitally reconstructed scenes frame by frame, blending historical details with artistic interpretation to visualize their past. The result is a poignant visual narrative that brings their unseen history to life. The collaboration highlights the potential of AI in preserving and imagining personal histories without physical records.

items.summary: 影片《Love, Rendered》展示了电影制作人与谷歌DeepMind如何运用人工智能技术，通过AI重现一对恋人未记录的过往。该短片以逐帧重构的方式呈现了他们的70年爱情故事，融合了科技与情感。

items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: a high-resolution map of human DNA
items.content: We’re introducing AlphaGenome Atlas, a database predicting the effects of every possible single nucleotide variant in the human genome.
items.contentSnippet: We’re introducing AlphaGenome Atlas, a database predicting the effects of every possible single nucleotide variant in the human genome.

name: Pushmeet Kohli
title: VP Science, Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist, Google Cloud

summaries.zh: AlphaGenome Atlas是一个预测人类基因组中每个可能单核苷酸变异效应的数据库。该数据库提供了高分辨率的DNA图谱，为基因变异研究提供了全面的数据支持。
summaries.en: The AlphaGenome Atlas is a new database that predicts the effects of all possible single nucleotide variants in the human genome. It provides a high-resolution map of human DNA, offering comprehensive insights into genetic variations and their potential impacts. The resource aims to enhance understanding of genetic diversity and its implications for health and disease.
